title: Ravin bar Kisi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Chullin 20b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.20b.4): “Ravina said: Ravin bar Kisi told me.” Hyman reports the Maharshal’s reading Rava; see the entry Ravya.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli has Ravina say that Ravin bar Kisi spoke to him. [Heilprin’s Ravya entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3206&lang=en) cites the same Chullin reading. Hyman attributes Rava to the Maharshal.
